lines.spoken: Our data is spread across portals like ASAP, GSCM, BDP and N-ERP, each packed with reports.
And then there are endless Excel files, emails, presentations and PDFs.
Finding one answer means knowing where to look, then opening report after report, and piecing it together by hand.
Meet Wizard. It brings every source together, in one place.
Wizard's local AI has learned our portals, so it knows where every answer lives.
So you can simply ask, in plain words.
Wizard finds the right reports for you: sell-out from GSCM, market share from ASAP, spend from N-ERP, and your targets in Excel.
Seconds later, you have a complete answer: a clear summary, the key numbers, and charts you can share.
Sell-out is up eight percent, led by Saudi Arabia, and our market share grew to over thirty-one percent.
Every number is checked against its source report, so you can trust it.
And your data stays safe, with authorized AI that only shows what you're allowed to see.
